baseline_models.focus_anchor: جاءت رسلنا بالبشرى ... قالوا إنا مهلكوا
baseline_models.mechanism: The arrival is not a neutral visit: a message-bearing embassy brings joy-opening news and immediately voices destruction. The branch of بشر as first indications makes the encounter a threshold at which opposed futures begin to show.

activation_trace.role: Bringing and making something present turns the messengers' arrival into delivery of the paired outcomes.
The messenger and carried message image makes the visitors an authorized communicative vehicle.
News that opens the face with joy supplies the positive pole of the encounter.
First signs or advance indications make the good news the onset of a larger transition rather than an isolated report.
Speech brought into utterance gives the destructive commission an explicit public form.
Falling into destruction supplies the negative pole announced by the same embassy.

changed_reading.before: Messengers arrive with good news and then separately mention a doomed city.
changed_reading.after: One authorized arrival opens a bifurcated transition, carrying generative news on one side and the termination of a civic future on the other.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أهل هذه القرية ... إن أهلها كانوا ظالمين
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated أهل encloses القرية and then reappears as the subject of the causal clause. Belonging, gathered habitation, misplacement, and withheld right therefore make the object of destruction a constituted civic body, not merely its buildings.

activation_trace.role: The group of nearness and belonging makes both repetitions of أهل mark a corporate population.
People gathered as a village supplies the collective spatial body placed under sentence.
A vessel that gathers what it contains lets the city function as the civic container whose contents are being classified.
Putting a thing outside its proper time or place gives the inhabitants' wrong a disordering mechanism.
Withholding or confining another from a right gives that disorder a social and relational edge.
Destructive falling is assigned to the civic body formed by those relations.

changed_reading.before: A place is destroyed because its residents are generically unjust.
changed_reading.after: The sentence dismantles a civic collective whose practices have displaced persons and withheld rights; the geography is named through the social body inhabiting it.

baseline_models.mechanism: The executor-facing declaration is paired with كانوا, which places the inhabitants' wrongdoing as an already realized condition. The verse compresses a temporal movement from settled disorder to imminent execution.

activation_trace.role: The destruction image supplies the act now presented as the messengers' commission.
Occurrence and presence in time situate wrongdoing as an established prior state.
Persistent misplacement supplies the condition from which the announced destructive act follows.

changed_reading.before: The utterance is a sudden threat against present offenders.
changed_reading.after: The utterance is an execution notice whose forward-facing act rests on a civic disorder already settled in time.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first rejects simple transfer of another's errors while allowing socially added burdens, then locally separates a rescued household from one member left behind, and later assigns each seizure to its own offense while making wrong reflexive. The collective أهل is thus a network of implicated agents under precise sorting, not an undifferentiated liability pool.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and belonging supply the corporate category whose internal accountability needs resolution.
Withholding a right supplies the relational wrong that can spread through a group without erasing agents.
Bearing a moral trust or burden gives concrete form to the rejected promise to absorb another's errors.
The image of a load made heavy preserves socially augmented liability alongside one's own load.
Escape by separation makes rescue an extraction from within the condemned population.
A remainder left after the others pass marks the explicit exception to household rescue.
Sin or offense indexes each seizure to a cause attributable to its bearer.
Repeated misplacement across the negated and reflexive clauses relocates the causal wrong from God to the actors.
The self or very entity makes the final attribution reflexive and individually indexed.

structural_cues: 29:12-13 deny transferable errors yet retain one's own and additional burdens.
29:32 rescues Lot and his أهل but explicitly excludes his wife.
29:40 says each was seized by its own offense and contrasts divine wrong with self-wrong.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nontransferable and added loads, extraction and remainder, and offense-indexed reflexive wrong. I infer that the focus ayah's collective أهل names a network that can be judged together while still being sorted member by member. A live alternative is that the burden passages concern a later accounting and do not explain the city's temporal destruction.

changed_reading.before: All who fall under the city's household label share one blanket guilt.
changed_reading.after: The city is a network of mutually implicated acts, but liability remains indexed: some are extracted, one is left, and each destructive seizure answers to its bearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus episode, Abraham is rescued, departs one domain for another, and receives a gifted, dispersing line bearing prophecy. Against that trajectory, the messengers' good news and destruction of a gathered city stage two opposed social futures: portable generativity and terminated settlement.

activation_trace.role: Advance signs supply the opening of a future that contrasts with the city's closure.
Belonging and kin-group formation make social continuity, rather than bare terrain, the common scale of comparison.
A people gathered in settlement supplies the fixed civic future that will be closed.
Destructive falling supplies the termination opposed to the preceding generative movement.
Rescue by separation releases Abraham from an attempted fiery termination.
Departure from one abode to another makes the preserved future portable rather than tied to its first settlement.
A gift given without exchange supplies the positive future immediately preceding the messengers' good news.
Small particles spreading supply a branch image of descendants extending beyond one location.
Prophecy and the one who reports from God give the preserved line a message-bearing continuity.

structural_cues: 29:24 rescues Abraham from a communal attempt to kill or burn him.
29:26 presents Abraham as migrating to his Lord.
29:27 places gifted descendants, prophecy, and scripture directly before the Lot sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rescue, migration, gifted descendants, and prophecy before the paired good-news/destruction message. I infer a contrast between a mobile line opened toward continuity and a settled collective closed by its practices. A live alternative is that 29:27 summarizes an independent blessing and does not specify the content or function of البشرى in 29:31.

changed_reading.before: The good news and the city's destruction are merely unrelated errands reported together.
changed_reading.after: The paired errand contrasts two social futures: a rescued and portable line opens into transmission, while a corrupt gathered settlement loses continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding indictment couples severing the road with performing the reprehensible in the public assembly, and the next plea names the قوم as corrupted. Outer circulation and inner deliberative space are both captured, so ظلم in the focus ayah becomes a city-scale predatory circuit.

activation_trace.role: The gathered village supplies the civic system whose routes and meeting place can operate together.
The familiarity and inhabitation of a place make the verdict concern an organized public habitat.
Withholding and confining others from a right gives the civic circuit its predatory function.
Road-cutting by seizure and obstruction makes the external path an active site of predation.
An extended traversable road supplies the circulation that the community severs.
The people's gathered club or council supplies the internal public space in which the practice is normalized.
The reprehensible thing that should be rebuked identifies what the assembly instead performs.
Departure from soundness and balance names the resulting condition of the people as systemic corruption.

structural_cues: 29:29 coordinates road-severing and public-club wrongdoing in one accusation.
29:29 makes the قوم's only answer a demand for punishment.
29:30 asks for aid against the قوم المفسدين immediately before the verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a blocked road, a public assembly doing what should be rebuked, and a people out of sound order. I infer one civic mechanism in which outward passage and inward norm-setting reinforce predation. A live alternative is that the verse lists distinct offenses without asserting an infrastructural relation between them.

changed_reading.before: The city is condemned for an unspecified aggregate of immoral acts.
changed_reading.after: The city has become a predatory circuit: it obstructs passage at its edge and institutionalizes the reprehensible at its center, making the collective itself the object of dismantling.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people's answer demands that punishment be brought, Lot's counter-speech seeks vindication, and the focus opens with an authorized arrival that voices destruction. The next execution formula sends the affliction down, while the later surah explains that hastened punishment has a fixed term and comes suddenly. The focus ayah is therefore the hinge where a taunting imperative becomes an arriving commission.

activation_trace.role: Coming and obtaining make the messenger arrival the event that answers prior speech.
Uttered speech turns the arrival into an explicit commission rather than an opaque omen.
Destruction supplies the content that converts the challenge into a consequential answer.
Painful punishment is the very object the defiant reply asks to have brought.
Vindication of the wronged gives Lot's plea the counter-demand that precedes the messengers' arrival.
Causing something to descend and reach its target turns the spoken commission into delivered consequence.
Hastening and demanding precedence generalize the earlier taunt as an attempt to control punishment's timing.
A fixed temporal limit blocks the challengers from setting the schedule.
The later statement that punishment would come echoes the arrival verb that opens the focus ayah.
Sudden surprise makes actual arrival reverse the challengers' posture of controlled demand.

structural_cues: 29:29 quotes the people's answer as ائتنا بعذاب الله.
29:30 immediately counters with Lot's plea for help against the corrupters.
29:31 begins with messenger arrival and an إنا declaration; 29:34 repeats إنا with descent of the affliction.
29:53-54 repeat the motif of hastening punishment and deny control over its arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the taunting demand, plea for vindication, messenger arrival, downward delivery, and later timing rule. I infer that adjacency and repeated coming language make the focus arrival an answer-event that reverses the challenge. A live alternative is that these are sequential reports without a direct speech-act reversal.

changed_reading.before: The messengers give Abraham advance information about a punishment already planned elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: Their arrival is the authorized answer to a demanded punishment: the challengers' imperative returns as a commission whose timing and delivery they cannot command.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's branch of البشرى as advance signs can be paired with the explicit clear sign left from the city afterward. Announcement and remnant become two temporal faces of evidence: one precedes the event, while the emptied civic container persists after it for reasoning.

activation_trace.role: First indications make the messengers' positive report a prospective sign at the event's threshold.
The gathering vessel image lets the city later persist as an emptied container of evidence.
Destruction is the transformation between advance indication and residual evidence.
Leaving an effect behind makes the destroyed place persist materially after its inhabitants' end.
A manifest mark identifies the residue as evidence rather than mere debris.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign makes the remaining trace publicly legible.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the human operation the remnant is meant to activate.

structural_cues: 29:35 uses منها, tying the retained sign directly back to the city.
The sign is both بينة and directed to a people who reason.
The focus precedes destruction with البشرى, while 29:35 follows it with آية.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an advance-sign branch for بشر, a destroyed city, and an explicitly retained clear sign from it. I infer a prospective-to-retrospective evidence arc across the event. A live alternative is that البشرى should remain only joyous news and should not be linked to the later آية vocabulary.

changed_reading.before: The destruction simply removes the city after a verbal warning.
changed_reading.after: The event converts the city from an inhabited civic container into a durable readable mark, bookended by advance indication and retrospective evidence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a later parable of protective alliance and woven shelter onto a concrete city. It remains anchored in the focus through أهل as belonging, قرية as gathered habitation, and هلك as collapse, while 29:41 supplies the explicit weak-house mechanism. Downstream prose should present it only as a possible social-architecture analogy, not identify the city or its residents with the spider parable.

activation_trace.role: Belonging supplies the social ties by which a population imagines itself held together.
Gathered settlement supplies the large-scale shelter analogue.
Collapse into destruction tests whether that collective shelter can actually hold.
Love, support, and alliance supply the protective relation the parable evaluates.
The web-weaving spider supplies the image of a constructed but unreliable protective network.
Shelter and dwelling supply the apparent enclosure against which the city can be analogically read.
Weakness of force exposes the inability of a socially woven house to protect its inhabitants.

changed_reading.before: The city is a strong physical enclosure that is overcome by an external destructive force.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the city is also a socially woven shelter whose predatory relations have already made its apparent protection structurally weak.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it turns messenger speech and civic destruction into a material analogy of differential descent, using branch-distant images of a rainless هلك landscape and a water-gathering قرية container. It remains anchored through the focus's paired good news and destruction and through the exact repeated descent-from-sky constructions in 29:34 and 29:63. Downstream prose should mark it as an ecological echo only, never claim that مهلكوا lexically means drought or that the two descents are identical.

activation_trace.role: Advance signs supply the potentially life-opening side of the paired mission.
Something gathered in a settled basin supplies the material container image for the city.
Land without rain supplies the deliberately distant image of a container emptied of sustaining life.
Sending something down to reach a target makes the announced destruction a delivered descent.
The sky as what rises and covers supplies the source-domain of the destructive delivery.
The same sending-down image carries water rather than affliction in the long-range reversal.
The same sky source holds the two opposite delivered effects in comparison.
Water conveyed by pouring supplies the reviving material delivered from above.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation supplies the positive reversal of civic destruction.
Dead land without vitality supplies the state that the second descent reverses.

changed_reading.before: Good news and destruction are opposed only as verbal contents of one visit.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the mission participates in a wider descent pattern: what comes from above can empty a corrupted civic container or revive dead earth, so outcome depends on what the receiving field has become.

strongest_changes: The repeated أهل becomes a collectively implicated but individually sorted network rather than a blanket liability class.
Road-severing and public-club wrongdoing turn ظلم into a predatory civic circuit linking the city's edge and center.
The taunting demand for punishment is reversed into an authorized arrival whose timing the challengers cannot control.
The destroyed قرية is converted from inhabited container into a clear residual sign for reasoning.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made burden, path, assembly, rescue, remainder, arrival, and sign branches converge on the focus ayah's terse civic verdict. The most unusual live activations treated the weak spider house as a social-architecture analogue and contrasted destructive descent with reviving sky-water.
remaining_uncertainties: The generative-line contrast depends on reading 29:24-27 as functional preparation for the البشرى rather than an adjacent independent summary.
The prospective-sign reading of البشرى uses a valid but non-dominant branch and may overconnect it to the explicit آية in 29:35.
The spider-house and differential-descent readings are analogical outliers, not proposed lexical meanings of the focus words.
